about: Korea links (differentiator B). KASA (Korea AeroSpace Administration) is a NASA Space Apps 2026 Space Agency Partner. Built 2026-11-14 during the event.

sites_of_korean_interest.name: Reiner Gamma (CLPS CP-11 / IM-3 landing site)
sites_of_korean_interest.note: Selected landing location '7.585° N, 58.725° W' from Blewett et al., 'Selection and Characterization of the Landing Site for NASA CLPS PRISM1 Lunar Lander Mission CP-11', LPSC 2023 abstract #1780, NASA NTRS 20230000531. Planned landing location, not a landed position.
sites_of_korean_interest.korea_link: Intuitive Machines IM-3 (CLPS CP-11) carries KASI's Lunar Space Environment Monitor (LUSEM) to Reiner Gamma (NASA CP-11 page: https://science.nasa.gov/lunar-science/clps-deliveries/cp-11/). Launch date differs between sources (2026 H2 vs early 2027): unverified.
sites_of_korean_interest.korea_link_ko: IM-3(CLPS CP-11)에 한국천문연구원(KASI)의 달 우주환경 모니터 LUSEM이 실려 라이너 감마로 간다. 발사 시기는 출처마다 다름(미확인).

ground_station.summary: Korea Deep Space Antenna, Yeoju, 35 m; receives Danuri in S/X band since 2022-08-15 (SpaceOps 2023 paper, unverified wording). Hourly Moon visibility in stations.json.
ground_station.terms: PENDING: may we use KDSA coordinates from NAIF kdsa01.tf? Question to Seoul ops/SMEs (owner: Dongju Kim).

danuri.summary: Danuri (KPLO) passes over each site and a geometric relay upper bound are in danuri.json.
danuri.caveat: Danuri carries no lander relay payload. Numbers are a geometric upper bound only.

shadowcam.instrument: ShadowCam (NASA instrument on KARI's Danuri/KPLO; operated by ASU)
shadowcam.citation: ShadowCam SOC, KPLO ShadowCam Data Archive, NASA PDS, doi:10.17189/y89z-kt98; mosaics: Grieser et al. 2025, LPSC 56 #2523 (https://www.hou.usra.edu/meetings/lpsc2025/pdf/2523.pdf)
shadowcam.terms: PDS archive, public; the PDS labels carry no explicit licence statement. Redistribution of image files in our repo is PENDING the question to Seoul ops/SMEs (owner: Dongju Kim). Until then we store links and label metadata only and the app may load images from the PDS URL at view time.
